notes: Malaysia: JTKSM covers Peninsular Malaysia only; Sabah and Sarawak have their own labour departments, so a contract for work there needs the local department instead. Channels read from the JTKSM complaints page on 2026-09-28. The letter is in Malay because the official complaint form is in Malay; have a Malay reader check it before it is sent.

general.authority_name: Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Semenanjung Malaysia (JTKSM) (Department of Labour Peninsular Malaysia)

channels.note: Sistem Pengurusan Aduan Awam (SisPAA), the public complaints system named on the JTKSM complaints page

channels.value: Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Semenanjung Malaysia, Aras 5, Blok Setia Perkasa 3, Kompleks Setia Perkasa, Putrajaya 62530, or any JTKSM branch office
